nct-dream-sweet-dream-hotel-incheon-2026.updateSummary: Separated the authorized ticket-sale record from the organizer notice and made ticket identity, pickup, showtime, and the airport-area return one go-or-no-go decision.
nct-dream-sweet-dream-hotel-incheon-2026.visitorDecision: This is a destination concert rather than a central-Seoul stop. Overseas visitors should decide on the Incheon transfer and return transport before choosing a ticket, especially if they are staying in Seoul.

decisionFit.availability: Upcoming on August 22-23; ticket inventory and fanclub windows remain controlled by the linked ticket and organizer notices.
decisionFit.bestFor: Dedicated NCT DREAM visitors who are willing to treat the arena and airport-area transfer as the main commitment of the day.
decisionFit.poorFit: A weak fit for a spontaneous central-Seoul evening because INSPIRE ARENA is outside the normal subway-centered sightseeing pattern.
decisionFit.timeCost: Budget a half day around the performance, with additional margin for ticket pickup, arena entry, and the return from the airport area.
decisionFit.commitWhen: Commit only after the ticket account, passport name, pickup method, showtime, and post-show transport all work together.

planningProfile.routeRole: A concert-day anchor in the airport area, not an add-on to a central-Seoul evening.
planningProfile.lockIn: The ticket identity, pickup window, showtime, and post-show transfer are confirmed together.
planningProfile.keepFlexible: Do not attach a fixed Seoul dinner or late reservation until the return route remains workable.
planningProfile.weatherExposure: The show is indoors, but the long airport-area transfer remains exposed to weather and transport disruption.

seoul-international-garden-show-2026.updateSummary: Separated the current Seoul Forest program from the October Maeheon Citizen's Forest component and added a location-first, weather-led commitment rule.

decisionFit.poorFit: A poor main plan during severe heat or rain, or for visitors expecting every advertised garden to be in one compact zone.
decisionFit.timeCost: Allow roughly two to three hours for the main gardens and walking, then add time separately if combining the visit with Seongsu.
decisionFit.commitWhen: Choose the correct location first and make it a fixed plan only after checking weather, maintenance notices, and the current garden map.
